summary: Independent review of PXD008292 found no blocker or important issues. All 81 RAW files map to plex A/B/C from header comments; iTRAQ 114/115/116/117 = WT/RN/HAL/RN-HAL holds for the three-replicate design; Qex02143-1 is plex-C phospho fraction 1; carbamidomethyl is correctly Variable; instrument is Q Exactive Plus; deterministic validators passed.

ontology_integrity.evidence: sdrf-tools check: 15 terms verified, 0 hallucinated, CLEAN, exit 0. Live OLS confirmed MS:1002634 Q Exactive Plus, MS:1000484 orbitrap, MS:1000422 beam-type CID, MS:1001251 Trypsin, PRIDE:0000627 DDA, UBERON:0001134 skeletal muscle tissue, NCBITaxon:9825 Sus scrofa domesticus, EFO:0010806 enrichment of phosphorylated protein, UNIMOD:4/21/214. iTRAQ114-117 accepted by validators.

source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE PXD008292 protocol: 45 min PM porcine muscle; iTRAQ-114 WT, 115 RN, 116 HAL, 117 RN/HAL; three pigs/genotype and three biological replicates; TiO2 phospho + non-modified; Q Exactive Plus; trypsin and mods including variable carbamidomethyl in dataProcessingProtocol. PubMed 29916714 MeSH Swine/Muscle Skeletal. All 81 RAW headers: Q Exactive Plus - Orbitrap MS; comments pigs-A/B/C and Phosphopeptides vs FTfrom. Readable .msf: iTRAQ 4plex method, DynMod_1-8 include Carbamidomethyl (C) as dynamic, Trypsin, 10 ppm / 0.05 Da.

file_mapping.evidence: PRIDE files list 81 RAW + 6 .msf, all projectAccessions={PXD008292}. SDRF comment[data file] set equals the 81 RAW names exactly (including Qex02143-1.raw). No duplicates of (file,label). PhosphoA/B/C and FTA/FTB .msf SpectrumFileNames match the plex file groups; FTCRLA82-94.msf range-unreadable (server error) but C FT files confirmed by RAW headers.

design_consistency.evidence: Recomputed: 12 sources (4 genotypes x 3 plexes), 81 files x 4 channels = 324 rows. Plex A/B/C = bio rep 1/2/3 with 0 header mismatches. Phospho fractions 1-14 and flow-through 15-27 per source; enrichment process distinguishes them. Qex02143-1 is plex C phospho frac 1 (header pigs-C; acquisition before Qex02143; vial RE5; original name Qex02142_*.raw). Channel map applied uniformly across plexes matches the single protocol statement for the three-replicate design.

omission_safety.evidence: Sex, developmental stage, strain/breed, disease, fractionation method left not available (Suppl. Table 1 and ACS full text unavailable). Instrument overridden from PRIDE Q Exactive to Q Exactive Plus using RAW headers. Carbamidomethyl MT=Variable matches MSF/PRIDE (not guessed Fixed). No unsupported per-animal demographics. Synthetic source names encode genotype+replicate only.

deterministic_validation.evidence: sdrf-tools check exit 0 CLEAN; score 100/100; structure OK; parse_sdrf validate-sdrf --template ms-proteomics exit 0; parse_sdrf validate-sdrf --template vertebrates exit 0 (both --use_ols_cache_only). reconcile --record pride.json flags cleavage_agent_unsupported (false positive: trypsin is in dataProcessingProtocol and .msf).
